release_read.basis: Q3 revenue $35.0m beat the company's flat-to-slightly-up guide and the $34.53m FXEmpire consensus, and the FY guide was narrowed to $142-146m with the low end held, so the feared second cut did not come; offset by a $16m quarterly cash drop and a lower year-end cash outlook (~$70m vs ~$80m), EPS -$0.46 vs -$0.44, against a 10% short near cash value.

release.released_at_note: 8-K ex99.1 dated 2026-11-09, before the 08:30 ET call; exact time of day not stated in the release
release.headline: Quanterix third quarter 2026 results: revenue $35.0m (+6.3% q/q, -13% y/y), FY2026 revenue guide narrowed to $142-146m

vs_bar.note: Benzinga carried $37.0m (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/QTRX/earnings-forecasts), against which it is a -5.5% miss; company's own Q3 guide was flat to slightly above Q2's $32.9m, which it beat

vs_bar.consensus_source: https://www.fxempire.com/stocks/qtrx/earnings (per stage E-P hunt); Nasdaq forecast null in brief

key_line.detail: Narrowed to $142-146m from $142-148m: low end held, top trimmed. Implied Q4 about $37.7-41.7m against Q3 $35.0m (+8% to +19% sequential), a smaller ramp than the +11-38% the thesis needed. No second cut. Cash $80.7m at 9/30 (from ~$96.9m at Q2), YE cash now ~$70m vs ~$80m guided in August.

guidance.detail: Revenue range narrowed within the old range ($142-148m to $142-146m, midpoint -$1m); adj. GM 48-50% kept; YE cash lowered to ~$70m. The street feared a cut below $142m.

call.detail: Call at 08:30 ET, already held before this review; content not found in search. CEO in release: 'higher than expected topline growth', commercial reorganization to help Q4. No call risk left in the session.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst action, press headline on the price or retail thread found by 09:21 ET. A TipRanks/TheFly 'Q3 EPS 73c' item is Q3 2025, not this print.

tape_read.note: Tape shows zero pre-market prints and no reference price (stale_at_open true), so the market has not visibly traded the release at all. Against a release read of +5% the visible price holds none of it; read as unknown rather than a measured undershoot. Small caps up: IWM +1.5% pre-market.

thesis_check.note: The short rested on a second FY cut; the low end was held, Q3 beat the company's own guide and the FXEmpire consensus. Only the cash burn ($16m in the quarter, YE cash cut to ~$70m) and the EPS miss support the short.

expected.open_lag_note: No pre-market prints at all, so the open is the first price discovery on a thin, 10%-short microcap and is unreliable in both directions; a bmo beat-and-hold with a crowded short and IWM +1.5% leans to further repricing up after the open rather than a fade.

recommendation.reason: De short rekende op een tweede verlaging van de jaarprognose, en die kwam niet: de omzet versloeg de eigen prognose en de ondergrens van het jaar bleef staan. Met 10% van de aandelen short, een ochtendmarkt voor kleine fondsen die stijgt en een bmo-uitslag die vaak de hele dag doorloopt, is de kans groter dat de koers tegen de short in blijft lopen; dek daarom bij de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als er voor 09:30 voorbeurshandel verschijnt die duidelijk onder het slot van vrijdag ligt (de markt leest de kasverbranding als slecht nieuws), dan liever tot 13:00 aanhouden volgens de vaste regel.
